title: Outdoor Smoky Jamaican Tofu Skewers
description: A smoky and creamy Jamaican dish featuring raspberry jam and flambe, perfect for a lazy Sunday, made with shojin-friendly ingredients and cooked on a cedar plank.

ingredients.name: extra firm tofu
ingredients.notes: drained and cut into 1 inch cubes

instructions: Preheat the grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a small bowl, whisk together soy sauce, brown sugar, and raspberry jam.
Add the chopped scotch bonnet peppers, garlic, and thyme to the bowl and stir to combine.
Thread the tofu cubes onto the soaked cedar planks, leaving a small space between each cube.
Brush the tofu with the soy sauce mixture, making sure each cube is fully coated.
Place the cedar planks on the grill and cook for 10 minutes, flipping halfway through.
Flambe the tofu by pouring a small amount of rum over the top and igniting with a match.
Let the flames burn for 30 seconds before blowing them out and serving hot.
